purpose: Owner-requested direct evaluation of the already final e00110950 hybrid029/32-card student against archived reason9001. New evaluation only; expired training stays closed.
pipeline: Challenger:029greedy>32cards, final e00110950greedy<=32, finishing-first; reason:017+beliefv1 archived9001 algorithms. NativeCPUone-thread,2workers,50sreason/3ssolver/300kTT/52slate fallback; no browser latency claim.
pairing: Identical physical108cardIDs/level/leader; challenger team0 then team1, both games complete or no pair.

statistics.primary: Per independent new deal, mean challenger signed final upgrade points across two swapped-team complete rounds. SampleSD/sqrt(N) normal95%CI; lower>0 favors challenger, upper<0 favors reason, otherwise inconclusive. Interpret only full1000pairs as complete preregistered result.
statistics.secondary: Per-side W/L/D, ranks,doubleup/down. Reason band requests/completed/deviated/minworlds/fallbackreason/timing; rawandreason observeddecisioncost. No pooledcross-study winrate.
statistics.stopping: 1000newpairs or original registered3h STOP/deadline; all results retained; no extra pairs or repeated output.
limits: Two homogeneousAI teams in one matchup, no humans/mixed teams/tribute/whole matches.
Different bases and policies; not a same-base search ablation. Timing and cold-cache allocation affect fallbacks.
Independent new deals exclude prior training/heldout reservations; unavailable remote history remains unverified.
No optimizer updates, data collection for training, webpage publication or automatic promotion. No expansion after seeing results.
